text: おれさまを　ポナヤツングスカ　してん　なんかに　とばし　やがるから　ロケットだんに　ねらわれるのだ！

structure.jp: おれさまを　ポナヤツングスカ　してん　なんかに　とばし　やがるから
structure.en: because he had the nerve to ship me off to some Ponayatsungusuka branch

structure.jp: ロケットだんに　ねらわれるのだ！
structure.en: that's why he gets targeted by Team Rocket!

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.explanation: やがる added to a verb is a rude way to show anger or contempt at the person doing it. とばし　やがる = 'has the nerve to ship me off'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ロケットだんに　ねらわれる
patterns.explanation: This ending says the action is done to someone, and に shows who does it. ロケットだんに　ねらわれる = 'gets targeted by Team Rocket'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.span: とばし　やがるから
patterns.explanation: から after a verb means 'because'. とばし　やがるから = 'because he ships me off'.
